Mission Local reported that a male after-school worker at Everett Middle School was arrested by San Francisco police after the school received a report of inappropriate contact between an adult affiliated with the school community and a student. The program was run by Mission Graduates; the report said it was unclear whether the man was an employee or volunteer and whether he was being held in custody. Police and the school district were investigating.
